senses.gloss: ch. sameto be laden; to carry, bear (h. נשא).
units: Targ. Y. II, Num. XIII, 23 (ed. Amst. טַעֲנוּ Pa.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joel 2:22">Targ. Joel II, 22</cite>; a. fr.—
B. Mets. 40ᵇ כיון דטָעוּן טָעוּן when they are once impregnated (with the fluid), they resorb no more.—Trnsf. to suffer, bear.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 9:12">Targ. Prov. IX, 12</cite>; a. e.
Targ. O. Gen. XLV, 17 טְעוּנוּ ed. Berl. (oth ed. a. Y. טְעִינוּ). Targ. Y. ib. XLIV, 13.—Esp. to help carrying, opp. פרק, v. preced.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 96">Gen. R. s. 96</cite> <he>משל הדיוט … טעון וכ׳</he> the common adage says, if thy friend’s son is dead, help carrying; if thy friend is dead, throw off (common people show no favor where no return can be expected). Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ top <he>מִיטְעוֹן תרי וכ׳</he> that two carry one load; a. fr.

senses.gloss: same. Ib. הוון מְטַעֲנִין להין they made them carry &c.—Part. pass. מְטַעַן carried, moved.
units: Cant. R. to IV, 8 דלית אינון … מְטַעֲנִין וכ׳ who are too feeble to be carried in a lectica, and whom they carry in a cathedra

senses.gloss: to carry. Ib. מַטְעִינִין. Y. Ḥag. l. c. אַטְעוּנְנוֹן יחידאין carry them singly, אַטְעוֹנִינוֹן וכ׳ they did so; אטעונינון צלוחיין carry straight through (without resting).—א׳ חינא = h. נשא חן to find grace.
units: Targ. Esth. II, 17 (ed. Lag. אִיטְּ׳, Ithpe.); a. e.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 5:5">Targ. Lam. V, 5</cite>. Targ. Esth. l. c., v. supra.

senses.gloss: to be carried (in a chair). Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ bot. מִיטְּעַן מערס וכ׳ allowed himself to be carried from one seat (where he lectured) to another. Ib., v. סְדִינָא.

units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 12:15">Targ. II Sam. XII, 15</cite> (h. text <he>ויאנש</he>).
